title: Internship: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
job_description: Job Summary The CEO Office Intern will provide support to the CEO Office team on high-priority initiatives led by the Chairman and CEO. This role involves conducting research and analysis on emerging technologies, AI applications, market trends, and industry developments to support strategic decision-making. The intern will also assist with PowerCash-related projects, Group Marketing initiatives, and selected special projects that require coordination with cross-functional teams. This internship offers valuable exposure to executive-level priorities, business research, strategic projects, and organizational innovation. Key Responsibilities1. Research & Analysis As part of the CEO Office, the intern will support research and insight development by: Researching emerging technologies, AI applications, market trends, and industry developments relevant to the company’s strategic goals. Analysing information from internal and external sources to identify key insights, opportunities, and potential business implications. Preparing concise reports, summaries, presentation slides, and briefing materials to support decision-making by the Chairman, CEO, and CEO Office team. Exploring how AI and emerging technologies are being applied across industries and identifying relevant use cases or opportunities for the business. Supporting research related to business strategy, innovation, client trends, competitor activities, and new growth opportunities. 2. PowerCash Projects The intern will support the planning and execution of PowerCash-related initiatives by: Assisting in research, analysis, documentation, and presentation preparation for PowerCash projects. Supporting project coordination, tracking of key updates, and preparation of materials for internal discussions. Helping to organise findings, data, and project information into clear and structured formats. Assisting with ad hoc tasks required to support the progress and execution of PowerCash initiatives. 3. Group Marketing Support The intern will assist the Group Marketing team with selected marketing and content-related tasks by: Designing posters, promotional materials, social media assets, and other visual collaterals in line with brand guidelines. Supporting the sourcing of vendors, tools, references, ideas, or materials for new marketing initiatives. Conducting research and providing recommendations to support marketing campaigns, events, or content development. Assisting in the preparation of digital content, campaign materials, and promotional collaterals. Supporting basic content coordination and administrative tasks related to marketing projects when required. 4. Special Projects The intern will support special projects assigned by the CEO Office by: Assisting with research, coordination, documentation, and execution of special projects or events. Working with different departments or project teams to support task completion. Supporting ad hoc assignments that contribute to the priorities of the CEO Office. Job Type: Internship Contract length: 6 months Pay: RM1,500.00 - RM2,000.00 per month Language: Mandarin (Preferred) Work Location: In person
